description: A non-target routing peer carrying the persisted login-expired flag (account login expiration disabled) is listed offline in the distribution group's map: peer-a keeps its DNS record and firewall rules but no WireGuard config and no copy of the HA route through it, so only peer-r1's copy remains. The envelope mode shows the client classifies the flag the same way. Legacy mode is excluded: main ignores the persisted flag.
